scope: Separate assistant contexts with scope-limited counterexample and cross-module review; not external human approval or full-product independent signoff.

implementation_owners./root/crawl_core: Native frontier/store/publication, migration, CLI capability and CMake/CI/native regression tests.
implementation_owners./root/crawl_worker: Worker publication/extraction/one-hop body protocol and read-hop retention with worker regressions.
implementation_owners./root: MCP raw boundary, controlled HTTP fixture/process E2E, planning/status/handoff and recorded final verification.

cross_reviews.scope: Original blueprint/acceptance preservation, native queue/accounting/SQL/publication/frozen identity, root MCP/E2E and final status/docs/evidence.
cross_reviews.method: Read-only source review, independent native runtime counterexamples, regression rechecks and structural planning comparison.
cross_reviews.limits: Reviewer scratch repro programs are not shipped. Committed native/E2E suites provide the reproducible execution gate.

cross_reviews.scope: Independent native worker-protocol/read/publication boundary and raw MCP scope semantics.
cross_reviews.method: Read-only native review plus controlled loopback/SDK reproduction; author implemented worker-side corrections after coordination.

cross_reviews.scope: Cross-author frontier, URL/owner/deletion/publication contracts and real core/worker/CLI/stdio MCP processes.
cross_reviews.method: Source review and final recorded ordinary, sanitizer, launcher and planning gates.

resolved_findings.problem: MCP SDK could coerce null/booleans/numeric strings, discard unknown fields, or parse the literal scope_path string null into omitted scope.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate the two new crawl tools raw JSON fields/types and absolute scope_path before the SDK; numeric ranges and authorization remain native. Advertise matching non-null schemas.

resolved_findings.problem: Agent-scoped header/meta rules, character encodings, and data-nosnippet titles/text needed a consistent independent publication representation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Versioned BzsBot/legacy alias policy, repeated-header scope union, separate bounded DOM extraction and safe title; no canonical-byte offsets are invented for re-extracted snippets.

resolved_findings.problem: Ordinary read/read_many refresh could widen registered links_only restrictions, while a valid candidate review with no redistribution field could throw unexpectedly.
resolved_findings.resolution: Core and worker enforce applicable original/final/redirect site ceilings; the optional review field is read safely without requiring automatic-crawl approval for an explicit read.

resolved_findings.problem: Valid prohibitions could leave stale indexed content when new body parsing, empty meta extraction or logical storage quota failed; an incomplete permitting prefix could also clear restrictions in a missing tail.
resolved_findings.resolution: Validate restriction-only observations independently of successful body ingestion; use monotone updates behind owner/lease/deletion fences and a logical-quota savepoint. Empty meta direct/batch reads retain their error and create no successful body receipt. Existing ordinary truncated previews are private, conservatively unindexed/unsnippeted and cannot grant publication.

resolved_findings.problem: A restrictive redirect response at A could be overwritten by an allowing final B, both in the crawl queue and in ordinary/bounded reads that discarded earlier headers.
resolved_findings.resolution: Persist crawl chain ceilings and retain URL-bound restrictive read-hop records; logical A and actual B publication identities are handled separately so independent B remains allowed. A refused private/unsafe target cannot discard the prior actual response restriction.

resolved_findings.problem: A previously read redirect representation could escape B policy, or a frozen A(B) row could expose B again after A retargeted to C; same-body snapshot reuse also changed the historic final URL.
resolved_findings.resolution: Bind current logical and actual representation policy plus immutable frozen-session representation identities and snapshot publication records; preserve restriction generations through retarget, same-content refresh and subsequent allowing responses.

resolved_findings.problem: Malformed successful worker artifacts could claim error/partial HTTP status, hidden additional redirects or a policy looser than their own restriction observation; malformed discovery could discard a valid restrictive observation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Check complete successful status, single-hop proof and monotone same-response policy; account trusted physical usage and retain independently validated restrictive observations before rejecting artifacts.

resolved_findings.problem: An edge recorded before frontier admission could retain followed=false despite later successful admission, losing the provenance decision on duplicate discovery.
resolved_findings.resolution: Deduplicate parent/target/source edges while monotonically recording the admitted decision; multiple parents remain visible and successful body state stays separate.

execution_evidence: ctest-final.log, five asan-*.log files, launcher_smoke.json and adjacent command records.

known_nonblocking_limits.description: Legacy schema5 could overwrite snapshot final_url metadata on identical-content refresh. Migration derives identity from retained metadata and cannot reconstruct identity that was already lost before upgrade.
Inherited retired private attempt replay can be classified E_WORKER_PROTOCOL while retaining historical usage and refusing publication; the current core does not automatically replay it.
